facts.fact: 开篇塔姆辛自陈怀疑自己正在发疯，全章的心理基调由此确立
facts.anchor: I think I am going mad.

facts.fact: 她躺床上用手机搜“Carlinsrest fairy hill”，想给怪事找非疯癫的解释；直接结果是“Scottish monsters”“Scottish mythical creatures”一类词条
facts.anchor: I opened the browser and searched for “Carlinsrest fairy hill”.

facts.fact: 她罗列无法解释的现象：邻居有两个不同版本，还有博物馆转台上的 Dolly、老人讲的“替身”（doubles）
facts.anchor: Two different versions of my neighbour.

facts.fact: 她自设二难：要么疯了，要么是杀人凶手；把超自然现象归因为“她的鬼魂来惩罚我做过的事”
facts.anchor: Either I was mad, or I was a murderer.

facts.fact: 她开始觉得自己搬到 Carlinsrest 不是为开始新生活，而是来送死
facts.anchor: It was beginning to feel like I had come here not to start a new life, but to die.

facts.fact: 祖母死因：肝癌合并肺癌（combined liver and lung cancer），不是意外或自杀
facts.anchor: My grandmother died of combined liver and lung cancer.

facts.fact: 确诊当天父亲送她入院，随后被转到北方一小时车程外的临终关怀院；她离家时以为当晚或几天后就回
facts.anchor: They gave her the diagnosis and moved her to a hospice an hour away up north.

facts.fact: 章末有人敲门（knock-knock-knock），她顾不得是谁，只想抓住任何人当救生筏，穿衣下楼——直接接 ch28
